recipes.title: Jammy Raspberry, Almond & Vanilla Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Creamy rolled oats swirled with frozen raspberries that melt into a ruby compote right in the pot, topped with almonds and honey.
steps: Simmer rolled oats and milk over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until soft and creamy.
Stir in frozen raspberries and vanilla during the final minute so the berries break down into bright ruby swirls.
Spoon into a bowl and finish with sliced almonds and a light drizzle of honey.
tips: Frozen raspberries turn into an instant warm jam right in the saucepan with zero extra pans.
Naturally rich in fiber and bright tart-sweet flavor.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Mashed Raspberry Chia Jam & Almond Butter Toast
recipes.summary: Warm whole-grain toast layered with creamy almond butter and quick no-refined-sugar jam made from frozen raspberries and chia seeds.
steps: Warm frozen raspberries in a small pan for 2 to 3 minutes until soft, then mash with a fork.
Stir in chia seeds, lemon juice, and honey, and let stand 3 minutes to thicken into glossy jam.
Spread almond butter on warm whole-grain toast and spoon the ruby raspberry jam generously on top.
tips: Double the jam batch — it keeps in a jar in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
Works wonderfully swirled into yogurt or pancakes too.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Thawed Raspberry & Dark Chocolate Bowl
recipes.summary: Thick plain Greek yogurt swirled with juicy thawed frozen raspberries, dark chocolate shavings, walnuts, and honey.
steps: Let frozen raspberries thaw in a small bowl for 10 minutes (or microwave 20 seconds) until juicy.
Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl and marble the juicy raspberries through the top.
Finish with chopped dark chocolate, walnuts, and a light drizzle of honey.
tips: Thawed frozen raspberries release rich ruby juice that naturally flavors plain yogurt.
Zero chopping needed if you buy pre-chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Ruby Raspberry, Lemon & Chia Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead pink overnight oats soaked with frozen raspberries, lemon zest, chia seeds, vanilla, and almond milk.
steps: Stir rolled oats, almond milk, chia seeds, lemon zest, and vanilla in two jars.
Tuck frozen raspberries into the top and middle of each jar.
Cover and chill overnight — the berries thaw directly into the creamy oats by morning.
tips: Frozen raspberries are ideal for overnight oats because they never turn mushy prematurely and tint the oats bright pink.
Drizzle with honey or maple syrup in the morning if you prefer extra sweetness.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Crushed Raspberry & Mint Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with creamy ricotta and topped with crushed thawed raspberries, fresh mint, lemon zest, and honey.
steps: Thaw frozen raspberries briefly and crush lightly with a fork.
Toast whole-grain bread and spread evenly with ricotta mixed with lemon zest.
Spoon crushed raspberries on top and finish with honey and thin mint ribbons.
tips: Crushing the berries keeps them spreadable and prevents messy rolling.
Cottage cheese works cleanly in place of ricotta.

recipes.title: Baby Spinach Salad with Fresh Raspberry-Olive Oil Dressing
recipes.summary: Tender baby spinach, cucumber, and toasted walnuts tossed in a silky ruby dressing whisked from thawed frozen raspberries, lemon, and olive oil.
steps: Mash or blend half the thawed raspberries with olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and cracked black pepper into a ruby vinaigrette.
Toss baby spinach and sliced cucumber gently with the raspberry dressing.
Top with the remaining berries and toasted walnuts and serve right away.
tips: Homemade raspberry vinaigrette takes 1 minute and has zero gums or excess sugar.
Strain the dressing through a small sieve if you prefer it seed-free.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken, Avocado & Raspberry-Vinaigrette Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender shredded poached chicken over leafy greens with creamy avocado, crisp celery stalk, and tart-sweet raspberry-lemon dressing.
steps: Crush thawed raspberries with a fork and whisk together with olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and black pepper.
Divide baby spinach, sliced celery stalk, avocado, and shredded poached chicken between two bowls.
Spoon the bright raspberry vinaigrette generously over top.
tips: Tart raspberries cut cleanly through rich avocado and mild poached chicken.
Use a teaspoon of honey in the dressing only if your berries are very tart.

recipes.title: Cool Quinoa, Chickpea & Raspberry-Mint Salad
recipes.summary: Light midday grain bowl pairing cooked quinoa and chickpeas with fresh mint, diced cucumber, olive oil, lemon, and ruby raspberries.
steps: Toss cooled quinoa, chickpeas, diced cucumber, and chopped mint with olive oil, lemon juice, and black pepper.
Gently fold in half-thawed raspberries right before serving so they swirl lightly without breaking completely.
Serve cool or at room temperature.
tips: Adding raspberries while still slightly frosty keeps them intact while tossing.
Balanced plant-based lunch with fiber, protein, and bright fruit.

recipes.title: Whipped Cottage Cheese, Raspberry-Basil & Almond Plate
recipes.summary: Cool high-protein lunch plate pairing whipped cottage cheese with thawed raspberries, torn sweet basil, sliced almonds, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a shallow plate or bowl.
Spoon thawed raspberries and their bright juice across the center.
Top with sliced basil, almonds, a drizzle of olive oil, and a pinch of black pepper.
tips: Sweet basil and cracked pepper transform berries and cottage cheese into a savory-bright lunch.
Serve with toasted whole-grain bread if desired.

recipes.title: Baby Greens, Tender Beet & Raspberry-Lemon Salad
recipes.summary: Steamed ruby beets over tender baby greens with toasted walnuts, thinly sliced red onion, and fresh raspberry-olive oil dressing.
steps: Mash half the thawed raspberries with olive oil, lemon juice, and black pepper into a tangy dressing.
Toss baby greens and red onion lightly with the dressing.
Top with diced steamed beets, remaining raspberries, and chopped walnuts.
tips: Vacuum-packed steamed beets from the produce section eliminate peeling and roasting time.
Tart raspberries accentuate the earthy sweetness of beets.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Warm Raspberry-Ginger Pan Glaze
recipes.summary: Flaky oven-baked salmon finished with a quick glossy sauce simmered from frozen raspberries, fresh ginger, lemon, and black pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush salmon with olive oil, season with black pepper, and bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
While fish bakes, simmer frozen raspberries, grated ginger, lemon juice, honey, and 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan for 4 minutes until saucy.
Strain through a fine sieve if desired and spoon the warm ruby glaze over the hot salmon.
tips: Straining takes 20 seconds and yields a silky restaurant-style glaze.
Pairs cleanly with steamed asparagus or rice.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken with Tangy Raspberry-Thyme Sauce
recipes.summary: Golden chicken cutlets bathed in a savory pan sauce of sweet onion, garlic, fresh thyme, cracked black pepper, and frozen raspberries.
steps: Season chicken cutlets with black pepper and sear in olive oil 4 minutes per side until cooked through; transfer to a warm plate.
Saute diced onion, garlic, and thyme in the skillet for 2 minutes.
Add frozen raspberries and broth, simmering 4 minutes while mashing lightly into a bright savory pan sauce; spoon over chicken.
tips: Frozen raspberries break down in minutes into a velvety sauce with natural acidity.
Serve with mashed potato or cooked quinoa to soak up the juices.

recipes.title: Crispy Herb Tofu & Warm Barley with Raspberry-Lime Drizzle
recipes.summary: Golden garlic-pepper tofu resting on warm cooked barley and wilted spinach finished with a vibrant raspberry-lime drizzle.
steps: Sear cubed tofu in 1 tablespoon olive oil with garlic and black pepper for 6 minutes until lightly golden, then wilt baby spinach right in the pan.
Mash thawed raspberries with lime juice and remaining olive oil into a tangy ruby drizzle.
Serve golden tofu and greens over warm barley topped with the raspberry-lime drizzle.
tips: The tangy berry-lime sauce wakes up earthy barley and mild tofu effortlessly.
Swap barley for brown rice or quinoa if desired.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots & Chickpeas with Raspberry-Lemon Glaze
recipes.summary: Caramelized roasted carrots and crispy chickpeas served over Greek yogurt with a tangy warm drizzle of raspberries, thyme, and lemon.
steps: Toss carrots and chickpeas with olive oil, thyme, and black pepper and roast at 425°F (220°C) for 20 to 22 minutes until tender and browned.
Simmer frozen raspberries with lemon juice and 2 tablespoons water for 3 minutes until glossy.
Spread cool Greek yogurt across two plates, pile hot carrots and chickpeas on top, and drizzle with the ruby raspberry glaze.
tips: Cool yogurt beneath hot roasted vegetables creates a creamy, comforting contrast.
Serve with warm pita or whole-grain bread.

recipes.title: Gentle Baked Cod with Raspberry, Cucumber & Mint Relish
recipes.summary: Tender flaky baked cod brightened with a cool ruby relish of lightly thawed raspberries, diced cucumber, fresh mint, lime, and olive oil.
steps: Brush cod fillets with half the olive oil and black pepper and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
Toss roughly chopped thawed raspberries, finely diced cucumber, fresh mint, lime juice, and remaining olive oil.
Spoon the cool ruby relish over the warm fish and serve right away.
tips: Delicate white fish pairs gracefully with bright berry-herb relishes.
Soft, flaky, easy-to-eat weeknight supper.

recipes.title: Velvety Frozen Raspberry, Banana & Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Thick ruby-pink classic smoothie blending frozen raspberries, ripe banana, plain Greek yogurt, vanilla, and chilled milk.
steps: Add chilled milk, Greek yogurt, banana, vanilla, and frozen raspberries to a blender.
Blend on high for 50 seconds until frosty and completely smooth.
Pour chilled and enjoy right away.
tips: Frozen raspberries chill the smoothie instantly without watering it down.
Ripe banana balances raspberry tartness naturally.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate & Frozen Raspberry Oat Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rich berry-cocoa blend combining frozen raspberries, unsweetened cocoa powder, rolled oats, almond butter, and almond milk.
steps: Pour almond milk into the blender, then add rolled oats, cocoa powder, almond butter, and frozen raspberries.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until rich and smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy.
tips: Add a teaspoon of honey or half a ripe banana if you prefer a sweeter chocolate shake.
High in fiber and deeply satisfying.

recipes.title: Creamy Raspberry, Avocado & Baby Spinach Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky magenta smoothie hiding tender baby spinach and creamy avocado beneath sweet-tart frozen raspberries, lime, and coconut water.
steps: Add coconut water and baby spinach to the blender first and blend 15 seconds until smooth.
Add frozen raspberries, ripe avocado, and lime juice.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until lush and velvety.
tips: Vibrant frozen raspberries keep the color pretty and completely mask the baby spinach.
Very soft, silky texture.

recipes.title: Bright Raspberry, Sweet Pear & Fresh Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing ruby smoothie pairing tart frozen raspberries with naturally sweet ripe pear, grated ginger, lemon, and cold water.
steps: Core and chop the ripe pear.
Combine cold water, pear, frozen raspberries, grated ginger, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend on high for 50 seconds until smooth and frosty.
tips: Sweet ripe pear naturally rounds out tart raspberries with zero added sweetener.
Add a spoonful of Greek yogurt if you want extra creaminess.

recipes.title: Cooling Raspberry, Mint & Oat-Milk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light pink garden smoothie blending frozen raspberries, fresh mint leaves, half a banana, chia seeds, and creamy oat milk.
steps: Place milk, frozen raspberries, banana, fresh mint leaves, and chia seeds in a blender.
Blend on high for 50 seconds until bright pink and frothy.
Serve immediately.
tips: Fresh mint lifts frozen berries into a crisp, spa-like drink.
Serve cold right after blending so chia seeds stay light.

recipes.title: Ruby Raspberry, Fresh Lemon & Mint Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Crisp, strained seed-free raspberry refresher brightened with fresh lemon juice, mint leaves, honey, and chilled water.
steps: Blend frozen raspberries, lemon juice, mint leaves, honey, and cold water for 35 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer, pressing with a spoon to leave all seeds behind.
Serve cold over ice.
tips: Straining removes every seed while keeping gorgeous vivid red juice.
Top with plain sparkling water for a crisp berry spritzer.

recipes.title: Crisp Apple, Raspberry & Ginger Ruby Press
recipes.summary: Naturally sweet freshly pressed apple and ginger juice blended with frozen raspberries and strained crystal-smooth.
steps: Juice the sweet apples and ginger (or blend cored apples, ginger, and water together).
Blend frozen raspberries and lemon juice into the apple-ginger juice, then strain through a fine mesh to remove seeds.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Sweet Honeycrisp or Fuji apples balance tart raspberries with zero added sweetener.
Using frozen berries chills the pressed juice immediately.

recipes.title: Hydrating Raspberry, Cucumber & Lime Juice
recipes.summary: Cooling pink refresher blending crisp cucumber, frozen raspberries, zesty lime juice, and chilled coconut water, strained smooth.
steps: Blend peeled cucumber, frozen raspberries, lime juice, and chilled coconut water until completely liquefied.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve to remove seeds.
Pour over ice and enjoy chilled.
tips: Coconut water adds gentle natural electrolytes and subtle sweetness.
Crisp, light, and completely seed-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Raspberry & Fresh Basil Cooler
recipes.summary: Freshly squeezed orange juice whirled with frozen raspberries and sweet basil leaves, strained smooth over cold water.
steps: Squeeze fresh orange juice into a blender and add frozen raspberries and fresh basil leaves.
Blend 30 seconds, then strain cleanly through a fine mesh into two glasses.
Top with cold still or sparkling water and serve chilled.
tips: Sweet orange juice balances tart raspberries effortlessly without added sugar.
Fresh basil gives a subtle garden fragrance.

recipes.title: Crisp Raspberry, Celery Stalk & Lemon Press
recipes.summary: Bright mineral-fresh juice combining crisp celery stalk, sweet apple, tart frozen raspberries, and lemon, strained silky smooth.
steps: Combine chopped celery stalk, cored apple, frozen raspberries, lemon juice, and cold water in a blender.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh to leave pulp and berry seeds behind, and serve cold.
tips: Tart raspberries and crisp apple give celery juice a bright, berry-forward lift.
Best enjoyed fresh and cold.
